problems.problem: Visible change from the last version: the vertical formwork joints at x≈190 and x≈915 and the upper horizontal joint at y≈715-725 are gone, and the contact crop [259,1171,821,1421] shows a clean continuous plane at the base. But the seamless monolith is still not delivered: one faint horizontal panel joint remains crossing the wall at y≈1075-1085, readable left of the bottle (x 0-339) and right of it (x 741-1080) at label height, plus scattered cast pits (e.g. x≈218/y≈447, x≈528/y≈203). A joint running exactly through the hero band keeps contradicting the declared 'no seams, no joints, no panel lines' void.

Contact crop [259,1171,821,1421] re-confirms a real contact shadow at offset_y 0 (correct, do not move): a dark occlusion core sits flush under the base. It is still narrower than the 402 px footprint - the core pinches out roughly 30-40 px short of each base corner - and the plane in front of the base stays uniformly light with no forward penumbra, so under the declared broad soft frontal light the monument rests heavily only at its center and lightly at its corners.

References 3-5 all make the environment react to the hero (Diptyque's ceiling glow refracted in the glass, Hermès's dust wrapping the silhouette, Prada's matched studio wrap). Here the radial glow exists, but the wall shows no local luminance reaction beside the dark silhouette and the glass edges keep warm specular streaks that ignore the cool #9aa0a4 ambient, so the bottle still reads slightly as a clean cutout pasted on the plane - the largest remaining gap to campaign-grade integration.

Hierarchy and alignment stay disciplined (logo 26 / title 72 / subtitle 24 in one tight left block, text_product_overlap all false, no glyph collides the bottle at x≥339), but the rule under the subtitle still renders as a near-black hairline and the declared copper accent #b0762a appears nowhere in the typographic block; the cool-grey / ink / copper monument grid executes as two colors, leaving the type block visually disconnected from the warm gold label it should echo.

changes.value: Monolithic flat raw cast concrete wall in cool grey, one single uninterrupted matte mineral pour extending edge to edge with no seams, no joints, no panel lines, no formwork marks, no tie holes, no pits, no corner, no horizon and no floor deck, only faint cloud-like mineral mottling, very subtle broad radial luminance falloff softly brighter behind the center of the plane and faintly cooling toward the edges, even diffuse frontal illumination with cool diffuse ambient wrap that gently grazes any standing object and leaves a faint soft luminance reaction in the air beside any dark silhouette, empty architectural void
